The dish looks like a paper plate about 20 cm across, holding almonds in a single layer with a few overlapping.

I counted roughly 35-40 almonds. A whole almond weighs about 1.2 g, so that comes to about 45 g. Almonds run about 5.8 kcal/g, so 45 g is roughly 260 kcal.

The pile looks fairly dense, so I'll assume about 38 almonds at about 1.3 g each, which is about 50 g and about 290 kcal.

{"kcal": 290, "mass_g": 50}
